Given: P × Q ÷ R − S × A

P × Q → P is the wife of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/891229688b5c300a7ac9e002f7203b4028d47ec85506f14e7670dcfaf54bbcb6.png] 

Q ÷ R → Q is the father of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf2292c8f178200739ec5199213459ef57a0e0f91fbbaa3a6578fdb64ad8ef2a.png] 

R − S → R is the brother of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ed178b033af64fac7e93d4379ab93d76d87b767387764062e637eb72b8e24b7.png] 

S × A → S is the wife of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ec7285efc7461969e4b93e5b889dcae9e6faafcba583037e9a96c1608d13ea1.png] 

Thus, S is P's daughter.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
